born August 1, 1990 in [[Trikala, Greece]]) is a [[Greece|Greek]] professional [[basketball]] player. He is 2.06 m (6 ft 9 in) tall and plays at the [[small forward]] position. ==Pro career== Papanikolaou began playing basketball with the youth teams of Proteas Grevenon and Aris, and he made his pro debut in the [[HEBA A1|Greek League]], with [[Aris BC|Aris Thessaloniki]], during the 2008-09 season. He was named the [[MVP]] of the [[HEBA Greek All Star Game#HEBA Greek Hopes All Star Game|Greek Under Age 22 All-Star Game]] in 2009. He was also named the Greek League's [[Greek Basket League awards|Best Young Player]] in 2009.[http://www.arisbc.gr/index.php?SCREEN=page&PageID=2111&LangID=2 Arisbc.gr Best young player, Papanikolaou.] In 2009, he moved to [[Olympiacos BC|Olympiacos]].[http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2009-10-signings/i/58160/3694/olympiacos-nabs-prospect-papanikolaou Euroleague.net OLYMPIACOS nabs prospect Papanikolaou.] With Olympiacos, he won the [[Euroleague]] and Greek League championships, in 2012. ==Greek national team== As a member of the junior national basketball teams of Greece, Papanikolaou won the silver medal at the 2007 [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] and the gold medal at the [[U18 European Championship Men 2008 Division A|2008 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]. He also won the silver medal at the [[FIBA Under-19 World Championship 2009|2009 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]]. Papanikolaou also won the gold medal at the [[FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship 2009|2009 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], where he was also named to the All-Tournament Team and won the [[MVP]] award.[http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.season_2009.compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.coid_ZH86crphIo6i4jss456gs3.articleMode_on.html Golden Greeks Conquer France.] In August 2009, he made his debut with the senior [[Greek national basketball team]] in a friendly match. He also won the silver medal at the [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]] with Greece's junior national team, where he was also named to the All-Tournament Team.[http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.roundID_7339.compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.season_2010.coid_N,JcameLInQJ0bZbC8GS61.articleMode_on.html FIBAEurope.com - MVP Albicy Headlines
